sentence: Captions turn every spoken word into text on the screen, right on the phone.
source: macOS AVSpeechSynthesizer (com.apple.voice.compact.en-US.Samantha) written to a buffer; each start is the sample position at which the synthesizer reported willSpeakRange for the word, plus the 0.5 s lead added before encoding to 16 kHz mono AAC (0.5 s of trailing silence).
